PluginData.FriendlyName: Kontrol Joystick / HOTAS / HOSAS for Space Engineers
PluginData.Author: Komandio Labs
PluginData.Tooltip: Joystick, HOTAS, HOSAS, controller, and button-box flight controls for Space Engineers.
PluginData.Description:
Fly Space Engineers with your joystick, HOTAS, HOSAS, controller, or button box. This Pulsar Legacy plugin receives your Kontrol desktop-app mappings and applies flight axes plus dampeners, lights, landing gear, and handbrake at the game's final ship-control update.
For setup, controls, and troubleshooting, open: https://github.com/komandio-labs/kontrol-adapters/tree/main/src/Adapters/SpaceEngineers
